segments.an10.173:1.3: Adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
segments.an10.173:2.1: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, adhammo, katamo ca dhammo;
segments.an10.173:2.2: katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho?
segments.an10.173:2.5: ye ca pāṇātipātapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho;
segments.an10.173:2.6: pāṇātipātā veramaṇipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
segments.an10.173:3.2: adinnādānā veramaṇī dhammo … kāmesumicchācāro, bhikkhave, adhammo;
segments.an10.173:3.4: kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī dhammo … musāvādo, bhikkhave, adhammo;
segments.an10.173:3.6: musāvādā veramaṇī dhammo … pisuṇā vācā, bhikkhave, adhammo;
segments.an10.173:3.8: pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī dhammo … pharusā vācā, bhikkhave, adhammo;
segments.an10.173:3.10: pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī dhammo … samphappalāpo, bhikkhave, adhammo;
segments.an10.173:3.12: samphappalāpā veramaṇī dhammo … abhijjhā, bhikkhave, adhammo;
segments.an10.173:4.3: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho;
segments.an10.173:4.4: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
segments.an10.173:5.3: Adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabban’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttan”ti.
